closure_definition: anonymous or credential-submitting users reach the correct login outcome without homepage content leaking
trigger: homepage request without authenticated state or login form submission
core_behavior: send anonymous homepage access to login, accept the valid configured credential, and reject invalid credentials with no authenticated state
observable_result: user sees login, generic error, or transition to authenticated homepage path according to credential validity

acceptance_criteria.description: anonymous homepage request does not expose authenticated homepage content
acceptance_criteria.example_input: browser requests homepage without authenticated state
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: login entry is shown or reached and authenticated homepage content is not visible
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: direct URL or repeated anonymous request still requires login

acceptance_criteria.description: invalid credentials fail closed with generic readable error
acceptance_criteria.example_input: unknown username or wrong password submitted from login
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: user remains unauthenticated and sees a generic readable error
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: empty or malformed credential attempt still creates no authenticated state
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: error reveals account existence or opens homepage

acceptance_criteria.description: valid configured credential creates authenticated access for the homepage path
acceptance_criteria.example_input: configured username and password are submitted
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: user proceeds to authenticated homepage path
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: valid credential submitted after a prior failure still follows the success path
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: valid credential is accepted without observable homepage identity path

priority_basis: access gate and credential validation are the prerequisite for any authenticated homepage behavior

protected_behaviors: invalid credentials create no authenticated state
valid configured credential is the only Phase 1 success credential path
business_constraints: PM defines WHAT-layer access behavior only; implementation chooses framework, storage, and cookie mechanics

verification_plan.expected_observation: login entry is shown and authenticated homepage content is absent
generic readable error appears and authenticated state remains absent
user enters authenticated homepage path and can be consumed by UNIT-2

design_decision_candidates.constraints: must not reveal whether username exists; must keep user unauthenticated
design_decision_candidates.design_handoff: choose readable generic error placement within PM-defined failure behavior
